rhythmSpec.wall0 (NNW, 4.9 m, gabled section): 2 identical bays, mirror-symmetric about the gable axis. Ground: 1 tall segmental-headed window per bay between stepped brick corbels. Floors 1-3: 1 segmental-headed French window per bay on its own stone balcony (black railing) carried by stepped corbels. Attic: 1 three-light segmental window centred in a pointed brick gable with stone coping and finial.
rhythmSpec.wall1 (NW, 5.6 m, entrance section): 2 axes: wide segmental window (bend side) + pair of narrow round-headed windows (party-wall side) on floors 1-3; ground: window under the wide axis, red double door with glazed upper panels and fanlight in a round stone arch under the pair. Painted eaves cornice; slate mansard with one three-light dormer over the wide axis.
rhythmSpec.both street walls: green glazed-brick hood over every opening, green glazed band at sill level on wall 1, grey stone plinth.
rhythmSpec.NE end wall (7.6 m): blank brick under the cornice (ivy in every capture), mansard hip above.
rhythmSpec.roof: slate mansard on all free walls (eaves 14.0 m, flat top 16.4 m per 3DBAG) plus the gable's saddle roof (ridge 17.4 m per 3DBAG) running back from wall 0, hipped into the mansard.
rhythmSpec.colour: brick sampled from ref-north-gable-2020.jpg (lit #5f4e45-#68564d) and the wall-colour review (#6d5e55); override lifted to #9a7666 so the in-game shaded north face reads ~#50433d, close to the photo.

faces.SE courtyard wall: INFERRED: no photograph; two sash windows per storey and a balcony stack at the east end (its edge shows in ref-north-far-2021.jpg / ref-northeast-2024.jpg).
faces.SW party wall: party wall with the 1904 neighbour (pand 0363100012152665), plain brick.

caveats: Ivy and wisteria that cover much of the NE wall and the gabled section are not modelled.
The dormer count on wall 1 is read from distant, tree-obscured views (one wide dormer seen); a second smaller one cannot be ruled out.
The 2024 redevelopment (hoarding: 4 apartments) may have changed the roof or rear; the newest full-height photographs are from 2021.
No chimney modelled; 3DBAG has a high point (18.3 m NAP-relative) near the west party wall that may be a chimney on the party wall.
